svg.title: FIWARE Made Simple: architecture
svg.desc: Application, back-end, and IoT layers of FIWARE Made Simple, with the telemetry and command flows.
svg.text: Platform architecture · Orion 4.5 · IoT Agent UltraLight 3.7 · STH-Comet 2.11 · Mosquitto 2.0 · MongoDB 8.2
Containers reach each other by service name:
internal network only, no outside access
any equipment that publishes over MQTT or sends HTTP:
Docker Compose on a server, VM, or cloud (x86_64) · internal “fiware” network
IoT device publishes a measurement to Mosquitto (or over HTTP)
Mosquitto delivers it to the IoT Agent (subscribed to /+/+/attrs)
IoT Agent updates the entity in Orion
Dashboard queries the history in STH-Comet
Application sends the “on” command to Orion (PATCH)
Orion forwards it to the IoT Agent (registration)
IoT Agent publishes /<apikey>/<device_id>/cmd; the device runs it
IoT device confirms on /cmdexe through path 1 → 2
IoT Agent sets on_status = OK in Orion (path 3)
Arrows start at whoever initiates the connection.
